GOHIKING rifle scope customer feedback.description: Product Description Hunter's Best Friend                                        The LS-300 is built ruggedly from high-grade aluminum with a hard anodized finish that stands up to abuse. From hard impacts, to the shock of large caliber rifles, LS-300 is built tough. Plus, it’s rain-proof and water resistant. Perfect for Paintball                                        The Survival Land LS-300 is the perfect green laser sighting device for paintball and airsoft enthusiasts. It's lightweight and compact design makes it easy to use in close tactical situations and the durable construction ensures years of service. Day & Night Visibility                                        The LS-300 operates at a wavelength that can reach up to 532 nm. It is four-to-five times more visible to the human eye than red lasers of the same output power, making the LS-300 a versatile alignment solution for any lighting conditions. Durable & Universal                                      The Survival Land LS-300 green laser is made of high-grade aluminum with a hard  anodized finish that stands up to high impact and the shock created by larger  caliber rifles. It works well in any weather conditions and it comes equipped with a 20mm Weaver or Picatinny rail mount and a figure-eight shaped 1" barrel mount. Powerful 532nM Laser                                      The Survival Land LS-300 is quipped with a CLASS IIIa green laser which operates at 532 nM wavelength and uses only 5mW of power, supplied by one 3 volt CR123A battery (included).  The LS-300 produces a beam that is highly visible in any environment and can be clearly  seen at up to 300 feet during the day and up to 1000 feet at night. Ease & Convienence                                      The Survival Land LS-300 green laser can be quickly and easily be turned on and off via a push-button located on the back of the device or by a momentary cable-pressure on/off switch that can be attached to the device in place of the rear switch. Precise Adjustment                                      The Survival Land LS-300 532nM green laser allows the tactical shooter to quickly and precisely adjust the windage and elevation of the leaser with just a few clicks. It provides a versatile tactical shooting solution in any ambient condition and under any tactical situation.
